title: Nourishing Smoky Norwegian Cheese Grill
description: A floral and indulgent Norwegian dish featuring lemon juice and smoke, made with a raclette grill and suitable for Jain-friendly diets.

ingredients.name: Glassy jelly
ingredients.notes: such as quince or apple jelly

instructions: Preheat the raclette grill to medium heat.
Slice the Norwegian cheese into thin strips.
In a small bowl, mix together the lemon juice, smoked paprika, thyme, and rosemary.
Brush the cheese strips with the lemon juice mixture.
Place the cheese strips on the raclette grill and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Drizzle the olive oil over the cheese and season with salt and black pepper.
Serve the cheese with a side of floral honey and glassy jelly.
Garnish with additional thyme and rosemary if desired.
Cook the glassy jelly in a small saucepan over low heat until it is melted and smooth.
Serve the melted jelly alongside the cheese.
